meaning: Source-only field/interface and interpretation review; not execution, partial-result consumption or scientific outcome approval.
scope: Read the post-consumer, continuation supervisor, frozen worker/loss/verifier and predeclared protocol; AST/compile only.
Did not open RUN, READY/permit instances, MASK, training NLL, predictions, model checkpoints or any ARC result proof. Did not execute main, a scorer or a model.
compatibility_checks: Consumer v/cv field names, six-phase COMPLETE/STARTED/EXIT, permit/archive fields and continuation model-complete keys match their producer assignments. The two-proof guard occurs before any MASK or training-resource read.
87MASK files per arm include empty S1 entries. Consumer skips no-data statistics naturally, permits empty subgroup means as null, and expects886 replay exposures rather than87 nonempty batches.

Worker loss interface returns CE,count,stats; the only non-JSON consistency tensor is popped before MASK serialization. Remaining NLL/MSE/mask fields match consumer names and original token-average/whole-hidden meanings.

Original87 event records supply stage,seconds,gpu_peak_allocated_bytes. Consumer reports update-loop timing and training highwater as descriptive measurements, separate from controlled inference windows.
Five continuation WAIT filenames and phase/seconds/checks fields match REMAINING. Their durations are compared with the producer sealed queue-wait total.
No consumer model/scorer/old-prediction call exists. It copies verified quality, reports existing per-ID comparisons, and only aggregates already-recorded training scalars.
interpretation_checks: Selection support requires gate macro above original and shuffle, actual mask Hamming above0 and a nondegenerate gate. Gate not above Naive explicitly prevents an overall-net-gain claim.
Highest observed shuffle is not promoted to an independently executable online method. A better original transplant can be retained without calling borrowed I-LoRA an invention.
Terminal-only100DEV does not identify just-acquired performance versus forgetting, significant effects, visual grounding or formal strongest-baseline superiority.
The actual max-hidden last-readout proxy does not certify all intermediate targets or useful gradients. Matching acceptance counts does not match MSE/gradient magnitudes.
Original preSTARTED refusal, unknown guard subcondition, prior gate work, queue/repair intervals and overlapping costs remain visible; no model retry or model-quality negative is inferred.
provenance_limits: WAIT individual SHA values are calculated and recorded by this consumer. The producer seals only their summed wait duration; CV is not a prior per-WAIT-file hash binding.

Parent explicitly confirmed preserved_gate_files contains only train_gate_STARTED.json,train_gate_COMPLETE.json,train_gate_EXIT.json. Under that three-small-proof contract the consumer performs no checkpoint-payload hash. Reviewer did not read a permit instance to obtain this confirmation.
Local collection must preserve the referenced relative MASK/event/archive/WAIT paths. This source review does not certify that collection has occurred.
authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored the frozen ARC worker and protocol and previously reviewed its verifier/loss core. Reviewer did not author this result consumer or continuation supervisor. This is an independent cross-file consumer review, not independent reproduction of the experiment.
